prompt:
Write a client review left on a freelance platform for Tobias Reyne after this project.

Project facts (the only truth you may use):
title: Tutor marketplace MVP
client: Brightpath Tutors
client_industry: edtech
start: 2021-10
end: 2022-02
engagement: fixed
stack:
- Next.js
- Node.js
- MongoDB
- Stripe Connect
- Twilio Video
implied_skills:
- marketplace payouts
built: A two-sided marketplace with tutor profiles, booking, video lessons and automatic
  tutor payouts.
metrics:
- live in 11 weeks
- 300 tutors
- $48k gross bookings in the first quarter

The review is from: Brightpath Tutors
Rating: 5.0 out of 5

Requirements:
- 2 to 5 sentences in the voice of a busy client, not a marketer.
- Focus mostly on technical quality; do not just repeat the project summary.
- If the rating is below 4.5, include one honest complaint (communication, delays or scope).
- Only mention results that appear in the facts. Never use: "marketplace payouts".
text: Tobias did solid work on our tutor marketplace MVP and kept the build technically clean from start to finish. He handled the full stack well, including the booking flow, video lessons, and the automated tutor payment setup, without making the project feel complicated on our side. We were live in 11 weeks, and the platform launched in a way that held up well as we reached 300 tutors and $48k gross bookings in the first quarter. Would work with him again.
